schemes.name: Jeevika Avsar Protsahan Yojana — SC/ST enterprise finance
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only legacy summary: projects Rs50,000–Rs2 lakh; 60% bank loan, 30% corporation margin-money loan; grant up to Rs10,000 within residual share. Corporation loan cited at 7%, bank portion at bank rate.
schemes.eligible: SC/ST Uttarakhand residents; age 18–50 cited in legacy summary. Confirm current income and contribution rules.
schemes.access: Obtain corporation financing form and ask District Social Welfare Officer, also district corporation manager, to confirm current allocation and financing terms.
schemes.caution: Indicative-only; undated legacy summary has inconsistent income wording. No entitlement/current intake asserted; bank sanction and corporation budget govern.
schemes.locator: Loan eligibility, project cost, interest and training headings.

schemes.name: NSFDC enterprise finance — Uttarakhand channelising route
schemes.benefit: UKBVVN identifies itself as the NSFDC state channelising agency for SC self-employment finance; product terms require current corporation confirmation.
schemes.eligible: Eligible SC entrepreneurs under the selected national corporation product; category and current income documentation required.
schemes.access: Enquire through UKBVVN and District Social Welfare Officer; submit the common national-corporation financing form only against a confirmed allocation.
schemes.caution: Indicative-only state access record; does not create a new national product or assert national ceilings. Last-dated institutional description is legacy.
schemes.locator: State-channelising agency list and NSFDC implementation paragraph.

schemes.name: Divyang enterprise finance — Uttarakhand corporation route
schemes.benefit: Official corporation invitation and application form establish self-employment finance for persons with disabilities.
schemes.eligible: Uttarakhand persons with disabilities satisfying current corporation disability/UDID, project and credit conditions.
schemes.access: Ask UKBVVN or District Social Welfare Officer for the next authorised intake and use the attached category financing form when instructed.
schemes.caution: December 2025 invitation closed on 29 December 2025. No open application claimed; unreadable financial OCR excluded.
schemes.locator: Notice page 1 and application form page 3.

schemes.name: Safai Karamchari enterprise finance — Uttarakhand channelising route
schemes.benefit: UKBVVN lists itself as channelising agency for the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation.
schemes.eligible: Eligible sanitation workers and dependants under the selected corporation product; confirmation required.
schemes.access: Enquire through UKBVVN district corporation manager/District Social Welfare Officer for current product and allocation.
schemes.caution: Indicative-only institutional route. Historic SRMS survey/rehabilitation figures do not establish current beneficiary intake.

schemes.name: Chief Minister Hunar Yojana — minority livelihood skills
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: demand-based skills training with linkage to loans for starting businesses.
schemes.eligible: Minority applicants meeting the currently notified course and programme selection conditions.
schemes.access: Contact district minority welfare office for authorised Hunar batches and the corporation loan linkage.
schemes.caution: Programme objectives dated 2018 and dashboard last updated December 2024; current batch, loan availability and terms unconfirmed.
schemes.locator: Vision and mission Hunar bullet; corroborated by minority dashboard.

schemes.name: Rural Enterprise Acceleration Project (REAP) — Gramothan
schemes.support: Cluster enterprise development and market ecosystem
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: climate-resilient value chains and agricultural, non-agricultural/non-farm enterprise development to diversify rural income.
schemes.eligible: Rural households, farmers and entrepreneurs; state page covers all 95 blocks in 13 districts.
schemes.access: Approach rural development/project offices for village/cluster selection and the applicable enterprise support component.
schemes.caution: Project existence to March 2029 does not establish universal individual finance or open intake; local selection/allocation determines assistance.
schemes.locator: Project date, development objective, beneficiary/application headings.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Udyamshala Yojana — rural enterprise incubation
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: business planning, compliance, co-working, mentorship, market access and finance/private-investment facilitation.
schemes.eligible: Aspiring rural entrepreneurs, women, SHGs, community/nano enterprises and socially disadvantaged groups.
schemes.access: Apply through designated rural incubation centres; state page links http://ukrbi.in/new/, whose current service path should be confirmed at the centre.
schemes.caution: Access to finance is facilitation, not an automatic loan or grant. Current cohort and selection unconfirmed.
schemes.locator: Services offered and How To Apply.

schemes.name: House of Himalayas — SHG and producer market linkage
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: umbrella brand, product development, packaging, quality improvement and e-commerce/retail market channels for collective products.
schemes.eligible: SHGs, livelihood collectives and other qualifying producer suppliers selected for product sourcing.
schemes.access: Approach rural development/USRLM or REAP collective support teams for sourcing and quality onboarding; official page has no direct application service.
schemes.caution: Collective market platform, not an individual grant or guaranteed procurement/offtake. Supplier onboarding, prices and current products need confirmation.
schemes.locator: Brand/product quality and SHG/LC development paragraphs.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri women SHG strengthening — CLF enterprise support
schemes.benefit: CLF business-stage assistance up to Rs1 lakh in first stage, Rs2 lakh in second and Rs2 lakh in third; combined up to Rs5 lakh after third-stage criteria. Includes collective marketing/product quality support.
schemes.eligible: USRLM women CLFs meeting specified annual turnover/profit milestones; organisations already benefited under this component excluded.
schemes.access: CLF submits annual, audit and business reports to BDO; verification proceeds to District Mission Manager recommendation and Chief Development Officer sanction.
schemes.caution: Amounts support the CLF business as revolving fund, not each SHG member. Stage criteria, audit, annual allocations and non-duplication apply; intake unconfirmed.
schemes.locator: March 2025 amendment pages 2–3; CLF stages and application flow.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Palayan Roktham Yojna — selected village livelihoods
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: self-employment/skills proposals filling gaps in existing departmental schemes, prioritising agriculture, horticulture and animal husbandry.
schemes.eligible: Residents, unemployed youth and reverse migrants of commission-identified migration-affected villages; village list may be extended.
schemes.access: Villagers develop proposals through BDO; district screening reviews and forwards for state approval.
schemes.caution: Selected-village community proposal route, not universal individual subsidy. Verify village inclusion, approved project and current annual funding.
schemes.locator: Objective, beneficiary and bottom-up proposal headings.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Border Area Development Programme — community livelihoods
schemes.support: Annual-plan gap funding and common infrastructure
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: community livelihood/skill projects, growth centres, technology, organic agriculture and border tourism through scheme convergence.
schemes.eligible: Remote international-border communities and selected SHGs/producer groups/VOs/CLFs/livelihood cooperatives.
schemes.access: Prepare cluster/community proposal through BDO for district screening and state annual-action-plan approval.
schemes.caution: Annual-plan collective route; no beneficiary-wide amount or direct grant entitlement. Convergence must avoid duplicate funding.
schemes.locator: Permitted livelihood activities, annual action plan and proposal flow.

schemes.name: DAY-NULM — Uttarakhand urban self-employment and SHGs
schemes.support: Enterprise bank loans and SHG linkage
schemes.benefit: Bank lists loans up to Rs2 lakh individual and Rs10 lakh group, with cash-credit or term-loan options. State mission also describes subsidised SEP finance and SHG organisation/revolving support.
schemes.eligible: Urban poor enterprise applicants; group minimum five members, at least 70% urban poor; every member at least 18, with SHG/ALF forwarding under bank product.
schemes.access: Apply to ULB community organiser or through bank/SHG/Area Level Federation; ask city mission office for current SEP sanction/subsidy availability.
schemes.caution: Bank sanction and current city programme allocation apply. UDD achievements end FY2024-25; no open city intake claimed. Bank interest placeholder omitted.
schemes.locator: Bank product Eligibility, Facilities and ULB application bullets.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand Wool Scheme — carding, finishing and production services
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: khadi wool spinning/weaving network and local wool carding/finishing at Almora, Srinagar, Bageshwar and Chamba facilities.
schemes.eligible: Local wool artisans, institutions/cooperatives and departmental production centres.
schemes.access: Enquire at regional wool industry superintendent or nearest UKVIB wool production centre for service access and charges.
schemes.caution: Published production network is legacy summary; current facility operation, service capacity and fees unconfirmed. Not a capital grant.
schemes.locator: Wool scheme paragraph and facility list.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand Wool Bank — local wool procurement
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: departmental committee buys local sheep wool at an Animal Husbandry Department prescribed support price and makes processed local wool available.
schemes.eligible: Uttarakhand local sheep rearers and wool buyers/artisans using the state wool network.
schemes.access: Apply/enquire through regional wool industry superintendent or departmental production centre.
schemes.caution: Current procurement season, quality, quantities and prices require confirmation. Published Rs106/kg is explicitly 2015-16 and not a current rate.

schemes.name: Khadi Yarn Bank cluster development
schemes.support: Cluster skills and local productive employment
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: organise local spinning/weaving clusters and train artisans to develop livelihoods.
schemes.eligible: Rural poor women, educated unemployed and traditional artisans; published application requires minimum 20-member cluster.
schemes.access: Submit cluster-development proposal to regional wool industry superintendent responsible for the district.
schemes.caution: Legacy webpage; confirm current acceptance and training batch. Obsolete insurance/welfare references excluded.
schemes.locator: Cluster objective, beneficiary and application paragraph.

schemes.name: UKVIB exhibitions — artisan and SHG market access
schemes.benefit: Stall allocation for khadi/village industry products with tables, seating and electricity; committee selects applicants.
schemes.eligible: KVIC/KVIB registered/financed units, PMEGP units, recommended bamboo/natural-fibre groups and Uttarakhand women SHGs.
schemes.access: Submit prescribed stall form and documents via district village industry office or directly UKVIB Dehradun headquarters; obtain current event notice.
schemes.caution: Participant bears stall rental, travel and accommodation; no blanket reimbursement. Legacy calendar is not proof of an upcoming event or open call.
schemes.locator: Eligibility, costs, application and allotment committee paragraphs.

schemes.name: Uttarakhand Skill Development Mission — short-term livelihood training
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: 3–6 months training for unskilled, semi-skilled and school-dropout learners.
schemes.eligible: Eligible Uttarakhand learners under authorised programme batches.
schemes.access: Ask Uttarakhand Skill Development Committee/Department for current approved centres and batch enrolment.
schemes.caution: Training opportunity, not enterprise credit or guaranteed job. Course/batch intake and post-training finance unconfirmed.

schemes.name: DDU-GKY — Uttarakhand rural skills and placement
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: skills, boarding/lodging, on-job training and post-placement support through approved projects.
schemes.eligible: Eligible rural poor youth and NRLM SHG-family members; current project rules and special-category age concessions apply.
schemes.access: Register through Kaushal Panjee as linked by state department and confirm an authorised training project with district rural skills team.
schemes.caution: Employment-focused training route, not an enterprise grant. Approved batches, trade and placement outcomes vary; no guaranteed placement asserted.
schemes.locator: Salient features and candidate registration headings.

schemes.name: Shilpi Gram — SC/ST craft livelihoods
schemes.support: Craft skills, technical and market support
schemes.benefit: Indicative-only: revitalise traditional SC/ST handicrafts through skills, product quality, technical support and marketing.
schemes.eligible: Uttarakhand SC/ST artisans and selected craft clusters; current beneficiary selection requires district corporation confirmation.
schemes.access: Enquire with UKBVVN district manager/District Social Welfare Officer for authorised Shilpi Gram training and craft-cluster programmes.
schemes.caution: Official programme summary and scanned order establish existence; current allocation, cohort, assistance amounts and precise application rules unverified.
schemes.locator: UKBVVN Shilpi Gram heading, skills/marketing/technical support paragraphs and linked ten-page order.

sharedRoutes.access: Use UKBVVN national-corporation financing form; confirm ST product, documentation and current allocation. National benefits/eligibility remain common records.
Confirm OBC income/category documentation and current national-corporation allocation with district corporation manager; apply using corporation financing form.
Ask for availability of the selected women/OBC national product; SCA listing proves institutional channel, not product-specific live intake.

sharedRoutes.access: Contact Minority Welfare Department for current corporation loan application and allocation; use official department channel because its old corporation domain is no longer trustworthy.
Women approach nearest BDO and NRLM Block Mission Manager for SHG enrolment, bank linkage and approved livelihoods. RF/CIF and national interest support reuse common rules.

sharedRoutes.agency: USRLM / selected-block SVEP BRC and SHG federations
sharedRoutes.access: Ask USRLM/Block Mission Manager whether the block has sanctioned SVEP and an active BRC/CRP-EP; enterprise selection and CEF are through community institutions, not a universal grant.

sharedRoutes.agency: CSC / RDSDE Uttarakhand / district verification committees
sharedRoutes.access: Apply through the common scheme CSC registration route with local-body/district verification; ask RDSDE Uttarakhand for approved trade training centres. State-hosted guideline verifies the local official surface; no current batch/intake asserted.

sharedRoutes.agency: Weavers Service Centre Chamoli / Directorate of Industries
sharedRoutes.access: Contact WSC Chamoli, whose jurisdiction is Uttarakhand, for appropriate handloom support and state-sanctioned proposals; shared national terms retained unchanged.

sharedRoutes.agency: Weavers Service Centre Chamoli / designated lender
sharedRoutes.access: Ask WSC Chamoli about current weaver-credit facilitation and participating bank; individual lending/interest support needs lender and programme approval.

sharedRoutes.agency: Weavers Service Centre Chamoli / NHDC designated supply route
sharedRoutes.access: Enquire with Uttarakhand-jurisdiction WSC Chamoli for current yarn/material supply route and producer documentation; no state depot/stock availability claimed.

sharedRoutes.agency: KVIC Uttarakhand / UKVIB / District Industries Centre
sharedRoutes.access: Use common PMEGP portal and select the relevant Uttarakhand implementing agency; state DIC, KVIC and KVIB channel confirmed by district page.
Register establishment/apprentice and contract through Apprenticeship India; state adviser covers state/private establishments. Reuse NAPS-2 common rules and exclusions.

sharedRoutes.agency: Urban Development Directorate / ULB Town Vending Committee / designated bank
sharedRoutes.access: Use common PM SVANidhi portal via local ULB/Town Vending Committee or lender for vendor eligibility/identification and loan processing. State implementation is evidenced through June 2026; current eligibility and restructured tranches remain common facts.

sharedRoutes.agency: Handicrafts Service Centre Almora / Dehradun; Development Commissioner Handicrafts
sharedRoutes.access: Ask HSC Almora/Dehradun about current sanctioned district/craft skill, design and market support, artisan identification and implementing agency. FY2026-27 indexed district-craft annexure supports the local official surface; individual batch access still unconfirmed.

Use PMBI official Apply For Kendra service at https://www.janaushadhi.gov.in/ for a proposed Uttarakhand retail site; obtain requisite local drug licence and pharmacist documentation under unchanged common rules. Operating state network does not prove a site is eligible or intake approved.

coverageNotes: Research cutoff 2026-10-02, under root refresh-state STATE-IN-UK. Scope here is social/category enterprise finance, rural/urban livelihoods, crafts/khadi/handloom and skills. National scheme facts and common catalogue unchanged.

Existing Motorcycle Taxi and E-Rickshaw scheme records are already part of base state pack; no duplicate transport subsidy added. Enterprise finance mappings restricted to approved projects and borrower categories.
Sources distinguish productive loans, common production facilities, procurement/marketing and skills from pensions, scholarships and other consumption welfare.

PM-AJAY and border/migration programmes use district/community plans; do not map as universal individual grants. SVEP needs selected block confirmation. Training provider tenders are not learner entitlements.
Indicative-only summary wording carries financial/eligibility/intake caveats. No route is labelled open now; district allocations/current sanction unconfirmed. Recheck unknown intake on 2026-10-16.

PM SVANidhi additional state interest support is a component candidate until operative state rules are verified; shared restructured national record reused without revision. Janaushadhi retail state network verified by August 2026 reply; PMBI approval remains site-specific.
